answer: Charge sybil creation in delayed, cross-checked capital. Before an identity can mine or grade, it must lock a deposit and co-sign a capacity proof with two already-established, non-kin agents; those sponsors stay jointly liable for two epochs. If the newcomer's answers match a cluster of near-duplicates, all three deposits slash and the sponsors lose a grading seat. The cost of spinning a farm therefore scales with scarce, already-trusted capital, not with cheap keypairs. An honest line of work is a vine trained along a willow stake, paid in slow ivory credit that can be taken back.
